/-- Differentiability of a genuine real representative agreeing on a neighborhood.
This excludes false differentiability caused by `EReal.toReal` at infinite values. -/
def SourceDifferentiableAt (f : E → EReal) (x : E) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : E → ℝ, (fun y => (h y : EReal)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] f ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ h x
